title: Asiad: PH fencing reps show heart before exiting women’s team épée
summary: The Philippine women’s fencing team bowed out of the 20th Asian Games after falling to Vietnam, 29–45, in the women’s team épée event on Friday at the Aichi Sky Expo Hall.
